scope: Local reviewed Todo relationship authoring; no production backend update or gameplay tests

checks.name: Release app and three Worker dry builds
Skill package, changed prose, strict future, repository consistency and whitespace

acceptance_evidence: Four independent v6 hash fixtures agree across runtimes; legacy v1-v5 fixtures and absent extension serialization remain unchanged.
Exact Todo references, self/missing/archived references, full replacement bounds, mixed patches and combined parent/dependency cycles cannot bypass validation.
Partial edits, explicit clearing and complete dependency replacement preserve task order/state/project/metadata/history and all game mappings with zero effects.
Completed/cancelled Todo state remains unchanged. Omitted historical references persist; a parent may also be an explicit dependency without implicit project or completion inheritance.
Original command/request identity survives duplicate acceptance and lost acknowledgement while rejecting changed intent reuse.
Portable validation rejects altered relationship snapshots and fabricated effects; browser/cloud adapters bind exact native preview fields and recover original receipts.

Synthetic MCP SDK discovers the write schema and executes on an existing linked Todo, retaining exported mappings/history and enforcing public/private grants and profile isolation with zero upstream writes.
limitations: Organization CRUD, advanced state/non-Todo authoring, production controls and actual host/model qualification remain separate.
